stem: During a redesign at Cedar Health, the booking API has to stay online if one Availability Zone fails inside a single Region.

choices.text: Place all instances in one Availability Zone and buy Savings Plans
Use at least two Availability Zones behind one load balancer.
Use one Local Zone subnet instead of multiple Availability Zones
Shift the API to a single Outposts deployment in one on-premises site

rationale: Running compute across at least two Availability Zones with load balancing addresses single-AZ failure resilience. Keeping everything in one AZ leaves a zonal single point of failure regardless of purchase option. A single Local Zone does not replace multi-AZ resilience for Regional workloads. A single Outposts deployment in one facility does not provide the Regional multi-AZ fault-isolation target.
